clue.text: Company with limited employee system finished business for the day?

definitions.meaning: a workplace where only union members may be hired, a restricted employment arrangement
a store that has stopped trading for the evening, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the union-only workplace arrangement; the other is a literal description of a store that has stopped trading.

clue.text: Song was first number one to be included

indicators.note: the numeral is placed within the word for leading, so it is taken in

parts.note: to be first is to have led
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A song that topped the charts as the first number one.
explanation.definitionFit: A German art song for voice and piano is called by this name, so it is a kind of song.

clue.text: Mark on a black beetle

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on the skin
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A mark seen on the shell of a dark beetle.
explanation.definitionFit: The sacred dung beetle of ancient Egypt is a specific beetle species.

clue.text: Silly people swim, I'd fancy, around end of boat

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit on either side of the last letter of the boat
fancy here means elaborate or reworked, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged
the end of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Foolish folk who, the speaker imagines, would swim around a boat's stern.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' rearranges SWIMID into DIMWIS, and 'around' puts that round T, the end of 'boat'.
explanation.definitionFit: Dimwits is a plural noun for stupid persons, matching silly people.

clue.text: Fast mover rescues maiden from women's group

indicators.note: to rescue the maiden is to take her out of the group, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a harem is the women of a household in some cultures
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A speedy hero saves a young woman from a harem.
explanation.walkthrough: M for maiden is a cricket scoring convention: an over with no runs.
explanation.definitionFit: This long-eared animal is known for its speed, a fast-running mammal.

clue.text: Last of cops up late pounding beat

indicators.note: pounding suggests something battered into a new shape, so the letters are rearranged
the final letter of the word cops is taken

explanation.surface: Police up late with hearts pounding on their beat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last of cops' gives S; 'pounding' rearranges S, UP and LATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To throb rhythmically, as a pulse does, is to beat.

clue.text: Change to 'all clear' bringing security

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters that follow

explanation.surface: Changing the signal to 'all clear' brings safety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Change' rearranges the ten letters of TO ALL CLEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Assets pledged against a loan serve as security for the lender.

clue.text: Plant place within fellow's grand design

indicators.note: the plant and place sit inside the word for fellow

parts.note: a fellow is a man
an aster is a daisy-like flowering plant
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: A man's grand plan for where to put a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A comprehensive scheme for achieving something big is a grand design.

clue.text: Beside mountain pass there's a tree

parts.note: a col is a low pass between mountain peaks

explanation.surface: Next to a pass through the mountains stands a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The cola or kola is an African tree whose nuts contain caffeine.

clue.text: Real Madrid excited — one put in the net?

indicators.note: excited suggests agitated movement, so the letters of the team name are stirred up

explanation.surface: The Spanish football club is thrilled to score a goal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' rearranges REAL MADRID. The net is not a goal but a butterfly net.
explanation.definitionFit: This butterfly is the kind of insect a collector catches in a net.

clue.text: Everyone in group provided with helmet

indicators.note: the word for everyone is placed inside the word for group

parts.note: a set is a group of things
all means everyone

explanation.surface: All members of a team are issued with a helmet.
explanation.definitionFit: A rounded medieval helmet with a neck guard is a sallet.

clue.text: Graduates returning to university for a day of rest

indicators.note: returning means the word for graduates is read backwards

parts.note: BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates
the University of Bath is an English university

explanation.surface: Graduates go back to university for a break.
explanation.definitionFit: The weekly holy day of rest in Jewish and Christian tradition is the sabbath.

clue.text: One's smiled awkwardly, with formal dignity

definitions.note: a past participle phrase: performed with ceremony

indicators.note: awkwardly suggests something set out clumsily, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone smiled awkwardly in a formal setting.
explanation.definitionFit: A marriage solemnised is one performed with ceremony and formal dignity.

clue.text: Yellow peril?

parts.note: a yellow fruit peel that is a slipping hazard

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase recalls an old political slogan, but here it is a literal yellow danger underfoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The discarded peel of this yellow fruit is a classic comic hazard to slip on.

clue.text: Show hesitation — that sometimes leads to sack!

definitions.meaning: to dither or waver in deciding
this word comes before sack in a backpacker's bag name

explanation.walkthrough: HAVERSACK is a knapsack: the word sits in front of 'sack'.
explanation.definitionFit: To dither is to waver, a Scots and northern sense of hesitate.

clue.text: Good person having complete problem with speech

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good person
utter means complete, as in utter nonsense

explanation.surface: A kindly person has a complete speech impediment.
explanation.definitionFit: A speech impediment involving repeated sounds is a stammer.

clue.text: Smart little son sitting on lap

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits above the other

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
to lap is to lick, as a cat laps milk

explanation.surface: A small boy perched on a parent's lap.
explanation.definitionFit: Slick means smart in the sense of polished or stylish.

clue.text: To the west Mediterranean island's black

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading from right to left

parts.note: Elba is a Mediterranean island, and the 's stands as part of the letters

explanation.surface: A Mediterranean island's western side is black.
explanation.definitionFit: In heraldry the colour black is called sable.

clue.text: Row produced by short communication

definitions.meaning: a row is a straight series of things
a brief note, as in drop me one

explanation.definitionFit: A line is a row of things, and also a brief letter, as in drop someone a note.

clue.text: A test for all except outsiders

indicators.note: dropping the outer letters of the phrase leaves the run tucked inside it

explanation.surface: A test suitable for everyone except outsiders.
explanation.definitionFit: A spoken examination is a test given by mouth.

clue.text: Use foil maybe for guard

definitions.meaning: to fight with a foil, a sporting sword
a barrier that protects or encloses

explanation.definitionFit: To fence is to sword-fight, and a fence is a barrier that guards property.

clue.text: Excited always when entertained by US agent

indicators.note: being entertained by someone means being taken inside

parts.note: a Fed is an FBI agent in the US
ever means always

explanation.surface: Always thrilled when hosted by an American agent.
explanation.definitionFit: A fevered state is one of agitation and excitement.

clue.text: Learned head of English impolite about use of computers, etc

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter
the impolite word goes around the computing term

parts.note: rude means impolite
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: An English head teacher is rude about computers.
explanation.definitionFit: Erudite means scholarly, having much learning.

clue.text: Demon among demons — terrifying

indicators.note: the letters are found among the following words

explanation.surface: One demon stands out among terrifying demons.
explanation.definitionFit: A frightening creature or fiend is a demon.

clue.text: Merlin wanders round behind king in citadel

indicators.note: the rearranged wizard comes behind, after, the king's letter

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess

indicators.note: wandering round suggests moving about, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: The wizard Merlin wanders around behind King Arthur in a castle.
explanation.definitionFit: The Moscow fortress is the best known citadel, a fortified complex.

clue.text: Busybodies said to get awards

indicators.note: said signals the word sounds like another when spoken

parts.note: to busybody is to meddle, so busybodies means meddles

explanation.surface: Interfering people are reported to win prizes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Busybodies' looks like a plural noun but works as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Medals are awards given for achievement.

clue.text: It's mad and stupid, imprisoning saint

indicators.note: the stupid word holds the saint within it

parts.note: inane means stupid

explanation.surface: It is crazy and dumb to jail a holy person.
explanation.definitionFit: Insane means mad, mentally deranged.

clue.text: Fish experts — they give evidence to police

definitions.meaning: a dab is a small flatfish
a dab hand is an expert

explanation.definitionFit: Dabs are flatfish, skilled hands, and slang for fingerprints taken by police.

clue.text: Godlike fellow giving the lady a ring

parts.note: her refers to a woman
O is shaped like a ring

explanation.surface: A divine man gives his lady a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth a demigod is a godlike fellow of great deeds.

clue.text: Returning home, chum entering study is invigorated again

indicators.note: the reversed home and the chum go into the study word

parts.note: to read is to study a subject

indicators.note: returning means the word for home is read backwards

parts.note: in means at home
a mate is a friend or chum

explanation.surface: Coming home, a friend entering the study is refreshed.
explanation.definitionFit: Brought back to life or energy once more is invigorated again.

clue.text: Lover no longer wanted is sent to it?

definitions.text: Lover no longer wanted is sent to it?

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

explanation.surface: A rejected lover is shown the door.
explanation.definitionFit: A way out is where an unwanted former partner is shown.

clue.text: Girl's state of anxiety — result of overeating?

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, and the 's stands as part of the letters
tension is a state of anxiety

explanation.surface: A girl's anxiety is caused by eating too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Swelling of the stomach is a consequence of overeating.
